note: Vendored copies of external normative schemas. The offline gate validates record consistency and local bytes; the separate network-conformance job re-fetches the exact revision's schema and license. Agent Plugins 1.0.0 requires a client to select locally supported validation rules from $schema rather than retrieving a schema while loading a plugin, so runtime artifact verification reads the vendored copy and never the network.
